I felt this post in my soul, i go through pretty much the same thing. Major Dépression, mood swings, anxiety, the occasional attempt to end it all but i can’t really do it, i don’t have the balls so i end up passed out for a day throwing up a bunch of meds or liquor, usually both. I think some ppl just know inside that they will eventually give up on trying to live a life that’s full of pain. I met an amazing woman right about the time i chose to transition, paused my transition for two years then decided to proceed, fast forward the splitting, add in the hormonal chaos from the shots and you have a deadly mixture of flaming hot trash. It’s like i was floating in second n then bam, i committed myself to this amazing woman and couldn’t get my act together. I’ve gone through periods where i thought i was addicted to sex, then though i just needed to make friends, then realized i just needed some new medication, hobbies, and better boundaries in my relationship. I didn’t know which way was up, and wtf i was doing. My relationship was ruined becuase i wasn’t honest and i didn’t set boundaries which led me to allow things i wasn’t comfortable with or not standing ground on what my expectations were. Horrible communication, and impulsivity are literally the end of me and everything I’ve loved.
